concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-chase-pricing-fees]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted Chase/Paymentech pricing-and-fee snapshot covering account-selected blended or IC+ models, successful-sale transaction-fee treatment, the own-Amex-account exception, Chase-managed reporting, and time-qualified chargeback fees; not independent Chase authority or a universal/current rate schedule
warnings: The source is Braintree-owned documentation and does not establish independent current Chase rates or policy.
Pricing-model assignment and some rates depend on account setup; IC+ assessments also vary by transaction factors including region.
